purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, viewer/service evidence, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: The official Walloon Geoportal and SPF Finances pages establish cadastral custody/provenance, and the official ArcGIS REST service returned safe parcel identity plus polygon geometry for a bounded envelope around the exact Liège WUP point. This is evidence of a public regional map service, not a citywide completeness or runtime-adapter qualification.
registryAssessment: Regional/local-in-scope registry/map custody is evidenced by the Service public de Wallonie Geoportal parcel page and catalogue record; the underlying cadastral source is attributed to the Administration Générale de la Documentation Patrimoniale (SPF Finances). No separate Liège municipal cadastral office was inferred.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official French Wallonia Geoportal page says the cadastral parcel plan visualizes private parcels and buildings throughout Wallonia, is available through WalOnMap or GIS software, and contains no owner/private-life information.
Official catalogue record identifies the current cadastral parcel plan, regional Wallonia scope, EPSG:31370, AGDP/SPF Finances provenance, and the ArcGIS REST service URL.
Official ArcGIS REST service metadata exposes one polygon parcel layer, maxRecordCount 2000, and JSON/GeoJSON/PBF query formats.
Official SPF Finances page describes the Belgian cadastral parcel plan and open-data provenance.

viewerConfiguration.observedTechnology: Official Wallonia Geoportal catalogue linked to an ArcGIS REST MapServer.
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: Layer 0 is esriGeometryPolygon in EPSG:31370 (Belgian Lambert 72). Fields included OBJECTID, CAPAKEY, CAPATY, COMMUNE, NOM_COMMUNE, CODE_DIV, DIV_NOM, SECT, RADICAL, BIS, EXPOSANT, PUISSANCE, VER, LASTUPDDTS, and geometry. Only CAPAKEY and geometry were requested for the bounded query.
viewerConfiguration.nativeFieldNames: CAPAKEY is the native stable cadastral parcel identity used for this packet; source fields were not retained in GeoJSON.

attempts.result: Official page retrieved; regional parcel-map scope and safety/provenance statements observed.
Official catalogue record retrieved; ArcGIS service URL, EPSG:31370, scope, and AGDP/SPF Finances provenance observed.
HTTP JSON metadata retrieved; one polygon layer, full extent, max record count, and supported formats verified.
HTTP JSON layer metadata retrieved; EPSG:31370 polygon schema and CAPAKEY field verified.

Anonymous bounded envelope query in EPSG:31370, intersects, where=1=1, outFields=CAPAKEY, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326 returned a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with 71 polygon features near the exact WUP point. No owner/address/private fields requested.

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained in the cohort artifact; bounded geometry and representative native IDs were inspected and documented, while raw unchanged response remains under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/.

geometryEvidence.query: 200 m envelope [234757.22,148185.00,234957.22,148385.00] in EPSG:31370 around transformed exact WUP point [234857.22,148285.00], returned as GeoJSON EPSG:4326.

identityEvidence.provenance: Native field documented in official layer metadata; not a synthetic row number.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Wallonia cadastral parcel map/service covering Wallonia.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Bounded anonymous parcel feature response near Liège exact WUP point.

remainingUncertainty: No city boundary query or complete city inventory was attempted; exact parcel freshness and service version are bounded by the official metadata observed at research time. A successful local query is not evidence of absence elsewhere, and no login, CAPTCHA, Cloudflare bypass, private token, or unsafe field request was used.

runtimeAssessment.reason: A real anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was verified, but runtime adapter qualification remains reserved for the serial reviewer.
